dedupe_keys.name: reproducibility package for robust nationwide measurement and benchmarking of mobile broadband performance across nigerian states

description: Chiamaka Nwabanne publishes derived mobile-broadband summaries and Python analysis code for Nigeria’s thirty-six states and Federal Capital Territory. The August 2026 Zenodo reproducibility package is free under CC BY 4.0. It uses Ookla measurements from the second quarter of 2025 through the first quarter of 2026 and compares national results with a contemporaneous contiguous-United-States benchmark. The archive includes summary datasets, sensitivity analyses, figures and validation materials, with administrative boundaries from geoBoundaries. These observations can inform regional communication-service performance assumptions and capacity-planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived state-level benchmark. Raw Ookla measurement files are not redistributed, and crowd-sourced tests need not represent every user or location. The public page does not enumerate summary columns, weighting choices or internal table formats, so those details remain unverified. The ZIP was not opened and reported robustness or reproduction checks were not independently run.
